headline: Corning (GLW) Stock May Be 34% Undervalued Following Soft Q3 Guidance
summary: Corning’s share price has more than tripled over the past three years, yet the current intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model still points to a meaningful gap to the market price. This raises the question of how much of this run is backed by fundamentals and how much is sentiment after the latest sell off.
